full_details: In the morning the property hand was already missing, so the afternoon was a bladder. At home the almanac said the carrier was in at the Bell. You did not go. After Titus you stood in the tiring-house door. Margery Pell said the butchers' men had clapped the cook. Abel Garnish held the company to a bladder until Saturday. John Heminges wanted the hired men's wages at ten shillings apiece, and nobody multiplied it. Raye had the baskets. A boy went to St Bride's and came back with Gilbert's aye, and the cup you owe him. Gilbert was not in the room. At her board you paid threepence and did not play the pie again. After supper you wrote four plain lines and did not answer the question from the fifth.
one_sentence: You played an old Roman, dead by the fourth act, and sent a boy to ask Gilbert to fetch what had come, while the hired men stayed at ten shillings apiece.
title: Ten shillings apiece, and a cup owed
